newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Grain, soy values thinly quoted.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Grain, soy values thinly quoted.

text.p: U.S. Gulf FOB grain and soybean basis offers were thinly quoted, with hard red winter wheat values edging lower, grain dealers said.
Light export demand for U.S. wheat continues to weigh on basis levels. U.S. wheat has not been price competitive with that from Argentina, Australia and Canada, dealers said.
